Female Operator Trainee Program 2026 (Cohort 4)

Location
Nationwide
Type of Employment
Trainee

Build the future of sustainable material handling with Bisedge.

At Bisedge, we're transforming material handling across Africa by delivering innovative, sustainable, and technology-driven intralogistics solutions. Through our Female Operator Trainee Program, we're creating opportunities for women to build rewarding careers in operations while contributing to safer, smarter, and more efficient workplaces.

If you're motivated, safety-conscious, and ready to learn, this program offers the opportunity to gain practical experience, develop technical skills, and become a certified Forklift Operator in a structured, performance-driven environment.

What you'll do

As a Female Operator Trainee, you'll receive comprehensive classroom and hands-on training designed to prepare you for a successful career as a Forklift Operator. Upon successful completion of the program, you'll support client operations by ensuring the safe and efficient movement of materials while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities as an operator will include:

  • Loading, transporting, and offloading materials safely and efficiently within the facility.
  • Conducting pre-shift inspections to identify equipment or material defects.
  • Operating forklifts in accordance with company policies and safety procedures following successful certification.
  • Inspecting forklifts and identifying maintenance or repair requirements.
  • Maintaining accurate shift records and operational observations.
  • Adhering to production schedules and operational procedures.
  • Cleaning and maintaining assigned forklifts and other material handling equipment (MHE).
  • Supporting efficient material movement to ensure seamless operational performance.

Safety is our priority

At Bisedge, safety is embedded in everything we do. Throughout your training and subsequent deployment, you'll be expected to:

  • Comply with Bisedge's Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Management System and all client site safety requirements.
  • Follow all company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
  • Maintain an accident- and incident-free work environment by identifying and reporting unsafe conditions.
  • Participate actively in safety training, toolbox talks, and continuous learning initiatives.
  • Contribute to maintaining a safe, healthy, and productive workplace.

﻿

Requirements

What we're looking for

We're looking for motivated women who are passionate about building careers in operations and are eager to succeed in a traditionally male-dominated field.

Successful candidates should:

  • Be willing to commit to a comprehensive four weeks training programme.
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to workplace safety and operational excellence.
  • Be eager to learn, develop new technical skills, and work in a team-oriented environment.
  • Possess a positive attitude, discipline, and a willingness to follow established procedures.
  • Be committed to building a long-term career in manufacturing, logistics, and intralogistics operations.

﻿Programme Location and Sponsorship

Please note that the Female Operators Programme (FOP) is a self-sponsored programme. Candidates are responsible for all costs associated with their participation in the programme, irrespective of their location of residence. This includes, but is not limited to, transportation to and from the training location, accommodation, feeding, and other personal expenses.

Successful candidates who meet the required assessment and programme criteria may be considered for employment and deployed to any of the following locations based on business needs and available vacancies:

  • NB AMA
  • NBC Benin
  • NBC Abuja
  • NBC Challawa
  • IBPLC Onitsha
  • IBPLC Sagamu
  • IBPLC Port Harcourt
  • NBC Port Harcourt
  • NBC Asejire

Benefits

The programme offers:

  • Comprehensive four weeks training of structured classroom and practical forklift operations training.
  • Gain hands-on experience in forklift operations, safety, warehouse operations, and basic MHE knowledge.
  • Opportunity to develop valuable skills and competencies for a career in material handling and logistics.
  • Certificate of completion for candidates who successfully complete the programme.
  • Expert instruction and hands-on operational experience.
  • A safety-first learning environment.
  • Opportunity for deployment to one of Bisedge's available operational locations across Nigeria.
  • Successful candidates who meet the required programme and assessment criteria will be considered for employment opportunities with Bisedge, subject to available vacancies and business requirements.

If you're ready to begin a rewarding career with a company that's shaping the future of sustainable material handling across Africa, we'd love to hear from you.


Why Bisedge?

At Bisedge, we believe in creating opportunities that empower people to succeed. Through our Female Operator Trainee Program, you'll gain industry-relevant technical skills, practical experience, and professional development in a supportive and inclusive environment.
